name: ailoc2-probe-extension
description: POC VS Code extension that logs rich edit and save telemetry to an output channel.

commands.title: AILoc2 Probe: Log Active Document Snapshot
AILoc2 Probe: Log Active Document Metrics Target

ailoc2Probe.metrics.persistEventsToFiles.markdownDescription: Write full event records to `.ailoc2-metrics/events/*.jsonl` daily files. **Warning:** Enabling this creates a high amount of files and extra disk I/O. Use only for debugging or detailed analysis.

ailoc2Probe.logging.verboseOutputChannel.markdownDescription: Log automatic probe events to the `AILoc2 Probe` output channel. Disable this to reduce output noise and memory usage.
